subject: Kickoff: BERTSeq2Seq for the rewrite features
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off BERTSeq2Seq. Our open-source work showed seq2seq models warm-started from pre-trained BERT/GPT-2/RoBERTa checkpoints hit state of the art on sentence fusion (DiscoFuse), sentence splitting (WikiSplit), and summarization (XSum, CNN/DailyMail, Gigaword). The product tie-in: the editor team wants exactly these capabilities - fuse, split, condense - as inline rewrite suggestions.

Scope for this short window (2/9 - 4/20): stand up the checkpoint-compatible seq2seq stack, validate against the released predictions on DiscoFuse and WikiSplit, then fine-tune on the editor team's rewrite pairs and get a quality readout with human evals.

Milestones: stack validated by 3/6, internal fine-tune + human eval by 4/10, handoff decision at window close.

Deshawn - staffing and budget please. This one has a real budget dependency, so let's nail it early.

Priya
